Deductions: '### Sources' (L639) is an H3 under the last H2 after '- - -'; several subheadings are topic labels, not claims: L423 '### 선택 기준', L438 '### 예제 모델에 적용하기', L484 '### GPU: `vllm/vllm-openai` 이미지'.
score_evidence.B: Mostly natural 입니다 prose that keeps English terms. Deductions: L15 '시스템 프롬프트처럼 반복되는 앞부분을 다시 계산하지 않게 해 주는 기능은 이 중 프리픽스 캐싱입니다' -> '이 중 시스템 프롬프트 같은 반복 앞부분의 재계산을 없애는 것은 프리픽스 캐싱입니다'; L251 '... 예로 들어 보겠습니다. 예를 들어 모든 요청이 ...' (예 repeated in back-to-back sentences); L267 '이 정책은 SGLang의 RadixAttention과 같은 정책이 됩니다' -> 'SGLang의 RadixAttention도 같은 정책을 씁니다'; the same figure-intro frame recurs: L29 '그림에서 눈여겨볼 곳은', L101 '그림에서 눈여겨볼 곳은', L148 '볼 곳은 화살표 방향입니다', L599 '그래프에서는 ... 보면 됩니다'.
score_evidence.C: Back-references are accurate and named (L455 '앞서 CLI 절에서 본 크기 접미사 규칙', L245, L289). Deductions: L414 scopes the engine-args explanation '(vLLM v0.9.2 기준)' while the table at L422-428 uses current-main fields and defaults (kv_cache_memory_bytes, the 0.92 resolution), so the version baseline shifts within the section; L226 and L273 rest on 'V1을 소개한 vLLM 블로그 글'/'V1 블로그', which the Sources list never gives.
score_evidence.D: Hard parts get worked examples at the point of use: the 7-token/block-size-4 table (L69-73), the CoW refcount timeline (L103-107), beam-search block table (L123-128), the A/B/C continuous-batching timeline (L171-177), the 512-token budget for chunked prefill (L213-218) and the 40-token hash chain (L253-259); all illustrative numbers are labelled. Minor: the CPU section (L506-545) spends many lines on env-var details compared with the shorter disaggregated-serving explanation.
score_evidence.E: Tables are real and well placed; figures referred to by content; ASCII timelines aid the hard parts. Deductions: the engine-args table L424-428 has vague or empty cells: '테스트 편의용 값' twice instead of the class defaults (2048 and 128 in scheduler.py) and '—' for max_model_len; '0.92' for gpu_memory_utilization omits that the declared default is None and resolves to 1.0 with the extensible KV cache (cache.py L216-227).
score_evidence.F: All 15 sampled claims are supported. Found outside the sample: (1) L316 'AMD GPU는 ... 현재 Python 3.12, ROCm 7.0, `glibc >= 2.35`만 지원합니다' is wrong against the current official GPU page, which says 'Pre-built wheels are available for ROCm 10.0' and lists rocm700 only for vLLM 0.14.0-0.18.0 (rocm100 is the nightly default); (2) L425 states the gpu_memory_utilization default as 0.92, while cache.py declares None -> '1.0 with the extensible KV cache ... and 0.92 otherwise' (partly wrong). Lesser: the 'saved compute ≈ h × p' formula (L279) is the writer's own heuristic, presented without a source or an 'author's estimate' label; L561 says kv_cache_metrics can be passed as an offline constructor argument but does not mention that LLM sets disable_log_stats=True by default (llm.py), which the metric needs turned off; the V1 blog numbers (L226, L273) are correct but uncited in Sources.
score_evidence.T1: The running example is paste-ready: uv install (L305-310, matches quickstart), offline LLM script (L322-341, quickstart verbatim with model swapped), vllm serve + curl /v1/models + chat completions with valid JSON (L351-375), --port/--uds/--config YAML (L383-475), Docker GPU and CPU runs with flags that match the docs. All Python blocks parse, all bash blocks pass bash -n. Minor: no openai-client snippet, though L377 points to it.
score_evidence.T2: Covers the topics the sources support in a sensible order (internals, then install, serve, args, deploy, operate, choose). Deductions: the comparison table L603-609 and L621 lean on third-party numbers (gingerlabs citing arXiv:2511.17593, Introl/Red Hat, an unnamed 8x H200 blog), flagged as such but still padding; the T Cloud CCE case (L578) is a single third-party deployment.
score_evidence.T3: Strong on internals and reasons: block table, CoW, beam-search sharing, FCFS/all-or-nothing preemption, swap vs recompute trade-off, V1 token-budget scheduler, hash-chain prefix caching with LRU and the xxhash multi-tenant risk (L293, matches cache.py), production-stack and disaggregated serving, and when vLLM is weak (L613-615). Commands and flags come from current docs; the paper's swap path is marked as V1-deprecated (L199). Deduction: the V1 description stops at the v0.8.1 guide (L228-237 maturity table), so readers do not see what changed since then; HPA advice (L572) reads as fact.
